item.title: Saturday Live Music at Spicy Vines feat. Take 3 Jazz Trio — Sat Oct 17, 3:00 PM — Spicy Vines
item.description:
Where unforgettable wines, live music, and good vibes come together. Join us every Saturday from 3–6 PM at Spicy Vines for a tasting room experience like no other — where top local musicians from across the Bay Area meet our award-winning small-lot wines. From Rock & Roll and Blues to Jazz, Bluegrass, and Americana, each weekend brings new sounds and new reasons to raise a glass. Take 3 Jazz Trio Take 3 Jazz Trio is an all-women Bay Area ensemble performing tunes from the Great American Song Book. We play a mix of uplifting swing tunes, smooth Latin tunes, and soulful blues and ballads. Michele Korb is our vocalist/guitarist. Susanne DiVincenzo is on bass. Barb Raboy plays clarinet, sax, and flute. Details No cover. Walk-ins are welcome, but this event tends to fill up quickly, so we recommend making a reservation. We are dog and family friendly!

item.title: Reuse in Art, Reuse in Life: A Conversation Between Ali Gass and Phoebe Schenker — Sun Oct 18, 3:30 PM — Petaluma Arts Center
item.description:
Join Alison Gass, Founding Executive Director of the ICA San Francisco, and Phoebe Schenker, Executive Director of Reuse Alliance, for a wide-ranging conversation about reuse in contemporary and historical art and why it is more relevant than ever.
The discussion will explore the many ways artists have engaged with reuse, from incorporating found and reclaimed materials to making reuse itself a central subject of their work. Together, Gass and Schenker will consider how reuse connects to broader cultural conversations about creativity, sustainability, consumption, and value, while also exploring how reuse can become a creative practice in our own everyday lives.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

Mahjong is a game for multi-generations; it keeps the mind sharp with a basic set of rules that can be learned in 30 minutes, and adds unending ways to add strategy and challenge; it builds community and sustains culture; it's fun and addicting in a wholesome way! 'Four Flowers Mahjong Salon' goal is to bring mahjong to the Sonoma County area. They currently teach at private homes, farmers markets, tasting rooms, and coffee shops!

item.title: Hallowine Walk — Sat Oct 24, 12:00 PM — Town of Yountville
item.description:
HALLOWINE WALK
Trick, Treat, & Taste in Yountville
Saturday, October 24, 2026 12:00 – 4:00 p.m. Washington St. | Yountville
Celebrate Halloween with a spirited afternoon in the heart of Yountville!
Join us for the inaugural Hallowine Walk: Trick, Treat & Taste in Yountville, where wine, Halloween, and small-town charm come together for a one-of-a-kind fall experience.
Your ticket includes a commemorative wine cup, event wristband, and tasting map.
